extensions.description: Required thermal realization contract. A later evaluator resolves local feature/port names and proves working gas, separate loops, positive inlet pressure drop, startup power and useful temperature difference. Authoring validation is not that proof.

Required per-instance exposure contract. Vacuum requires unblocked heat exchange cells and an exterior path; sunlight checks potential unobstructed rays at sample directions, not constant night-time output. A later native evaluator resolves local feature IDs and actual exposure.
Persist an explicit native source/sink binding between the selected local machine instances. One-to-one behavior and native operating power must be checked later; proximity is not a binding.
A local repairability preference: placement permits creating the link under the selected source range. Saved native bindings may restore outside that range; this is not a runtime disconnection rule.

Local research consumer obligation. Resolve an eligible server on the same native grid and register the client with it. This is software association, not a cable or room adjacency. Power is a separate operational prerequisite; no global network is synthesized by this definition.

Local two-gate realization. The named feature instances realize the inner shared boundary and outer perimeter rather than duplicating those doors. Later evaluate interlocks, safe pressure cycling and suited exterior egress.

Local magnet footprint obligation exposed to future placement: use the selected native debris pool and magnet orientation, test rotated grid bounds and preserve viable exterior placements. No global packing or reservations are computed here; the future algorithm propagates conflicts with other local footprints.

Local equipment access contract: preserve usable input, retrieval and servicing positions; normal staff access must not require crossing the hazardous reclaimer footprint. Later geometry and power checks remain required.

This local telecom installation offers its configured channels through its own selected provider features. Verify native encryption keys and local machine power; radioReach describes same-map native reach, not a global station coverage obligation. Another installation may independently offer channels elsewhere. This is a required future evaluator contract; structural validation does not implement or certify it.

Resolve only this subject space's declared features, inputs and outputs. Incoming power is an unresolved external service need until a relationship supplies it; local conversion/storage and outputs must use real native nodes. Do not search other rooms, enumerate station consumers or infer upward requirements. A later algorithm can propagate these local obligations. This is a required future evaluator contract; structural validation does not implement or certify it.

This subject's gas-processing installation must realize its declared input, breathable output, contaminated return and control interfaces. Resolve only local feature IDs and ports. No room/zone enumeration, station-wide coverage or upward requirement propagation is part of this rule. This is a required future evaluator contract; structural validation does not implement or certify it.

This generator offers gravity on its own host grid only. Resolve local feature IDs and validate native activation, direct-grid parenting, power/charge and collision footprint. The rule does not enumerate all station grids or impose gravity on another room/grid. This is a required future evaluator contract; structural validation does not implement or certify it.

Local native operating contract. Resolve these local feature IDs, portable docking and configured devices, then prove each pod can support its intended treatment. Authoring validation and symbolic links provide no runtime certification.

Local maintained-temperature contract. A physical evaluator resolves local equipment IDs, proves gas exchange and power, then evaluates room gas temperature under the declared use. Saved initial air and symbolic links are insufficient.

Local room entrance contract. A future physical evaluator checks every routine crew entrance against the named interface policy; upstream credential-correct approaches remain independent requirements. No route propagation is performed here.

Persist the selected native source/sink signal ports between the bound local feature instances. Signal devices may have multiple sinks; this does not claim artifact-style native one-to-one exclusivity. Use native power prerequisites only where the selected devices actually have them. Physical/runtime verification is deferred.

Local orientation-aware storage access. For each selected feature instance, read the chosen native component offset, rotate with its actual pose, and preserve the opening/ejection position and authorized approach on usable surface. Generic working area elsewhere is insufficient. Native collision and path evaluation remain required; a floor tile or absence of a full wall is not a runtime certificate.

Local multipart footprint and commissioning capability. player_setup permits staged finished/unfinished parts and requires construction supplies; commissioned requires native completed nodes. Neither mode requires firing at round start. A later evaluator must prove this contract; YAML validation does not commission machines.

Local AME kit, build footprint, adjacent controller and fuel service. Packed initial inventory is distinct from a commissioned connected core. The target footprint reuses the existing controller and consumes/deploys kit contents, not duplicate machines. A later evaluator must prove this contract; YAML validation does not commission machines.

Local containment commissioning envelope. Match support to each selected generator prototype; optional unused collector families are not forced. player_setup may stage equipment, but reserves a realizable operating arrangement. Counts alone do not prove beam lanes, active fields or energy collection. A later evaluator must prove this contract; YAML validation does not commission machines.

The local generator consumer requires a compatible PA emitting toward its commissioning envelope. The target feature identifies the control of the reserved assembly; use its named emitter parts and native collision/lifetime behavior. No generic cable or doorway satisfies this beam need. A later evaluator must prove this contract; YAML validation does not commission machines.

Local console operator/input contract. Native updater targeting is component-based, not a physical cable or grid-distance link to a core. No law is uploaded automatically by this definition. A later evaluator must prove this contract; YAML validation does not commission machines.

Consumer-owned receiving-pad obligation: from is the selected optional pad, to is an eligible approving console. The native signal runs console OrderSender to pad OrderReceiver. Multiple consoles may share a pad; this is not an exclusive artifact pair. Later evaluate and persist actual links, owning station, power/anchoring and local retrieval geometry. Structural validation proves none of those runtime facts.

Resolve this installation's intake, terminal and named relationship only. Validate same-tile entry assemblies, native operating state, directed/tag-compatible paths and the actual bound terminal's ejection/receiving geometry. A disconnected route is not a valid substitute for the named terminal. routingTags are expected initial native payload tags and must match the selected intake configuration; an empty list is valid for an authored untagged intake. Never infer payload tags from a service medium. No other station intakes or networks are enumerated. A future evaluator must implement the proof.

Resolve local controls and the actual operator standing/approach positions. Preserve authorized use from the declared host environment without entering excluded process spaces. This is a local spatial obligation requiring a future evaluator.
Commission native GenpopLocker, PrisonerIDCard expiry/access and property retrieval using separate directed admission/release lanes.
